summary: OrdinaryAssignment supplies versioned immutable workspace, assessment, profile, specification and optional-experiment assignment data. The pure deterministic policy checks hard feasibility before declared comparable economics or stable fallback; its separate verifier receives authoritative completeness and obligations independently, reconstructs requirements and recomputes joint capacity, held reservations, recovery slots, path conflicts and preference totals. Maintained F# framework and composed Python/JavaScript source fixtures exercise positive ordinary selections and refusal controls without installed execution. The compiled Host report compares actual MainAdmissionPreparationRequest fields, actual input bytes and explicitly supplied identity/journal context, with owned residuals for original budgets/resources, enforcing context/configuration, durable custody and acceptance. Its output is informational and grants no admission, reservation allocation or dispatch. Multi-repository/local data remain complete and current protocol incompatibility is explicit. Existing production experiment/journal/runner paths remain authoritative; production migration, installed adoption and full LEARN parent acceptance are separate.
title: Ordinary assignment kernel and Main correspondence boundary
